qualification: solar stations commissioned on/after 2014-01-01; older projects require approval-date evidence
central_support_basis: regional benchmark tariff minus local coal reference
distributed_basis: full generation subsidy; surplus sold at local coal reference; self-consumption is not a grid sale
blocked_uses: backdate eligibility for older projects without approval dates
equate a standard eligibility period with actual cash collection
treat aggregate solar as an identified distributed/central mixture
